forge-001.name: Bellows Apprentice
forge-001.flavor: The first job is to keep the fire alive.

forge-002.name: Wandering Spark
forge-002.flavor: No one knows which forge it escaped from.

forge-003.name: Copper Hound
forge-003.flavor: It smells the salt and runs toward the light.

forge-004.name: Anvil Guard
forge-004.flavor: He took more blows than the anvil itself.

forge-005.name: Ember Thrower
forge-005.flavor: A well-thrown ember is worth a sword.

forge-007.name: Slag Brute
forge-007.flavor: Made from scraps, and angry about it.

forge-008.name: Flare Signaller
forge-008.flavor: Her first flare is always a greeting.

forge-009.name: Tidebreaker Smith
forge-009.flavor: He strikes the iron and the sea steps back.

forge-010.name: Rivet Archer
forge-010.flavor: Every rivet has a name carved on it.

forge-011.name: Foundry Champion
forge-011.flavor: The foundry sings when he fights.

forge-014.name: Mother of Furnaces
forge-014.flavor: Every fire in the archipelago is her child.

forge-016.name: Sparkburst
forge-016.flavor: A beacon sees the light. Then it sees the fire.

forge-018.name: Bellows Gust
forge-018.flavor: The hot wind pushes the sea too.

forge-019.name: Molten Rain
forge-019.flavor: The drops never touch the water.

forge-020.name: Heat Surge
forge-020.flavor: At high tide, steam becomes a weapon.

forge-021.name: Overheat
forge-021.flavor: A strong fire asks for a price.

forge-024.name: Blazing Foundry
forge-024.flavor: Here the air itself is a weapon.

forge-025.name: Ember Tithe
forge-025.flavor: The forge lends. The forge takes back.

sprout-002.name: Kelp Weaver
sprout-002.flavor: Every night she adds a thread.

sprout-003.name: Reef Sentinel
sprout-003.flavor: It does not move. It does not need to.

sprout-004.name: Tidepool Tender
sprout-004.flavor: She brings clear water to tired beacons.

sprout-010.name: Old Root Elder
sprout-010.flavor: His roots touch the bottom of the sea.

sprout-011.name: Great Kelp Mother
sprout-011.flavor: The drowned forest breathes with her.

sprout-013.name: Brine Shepherd
sprout-013.flavor: She guides the tide like a flock.

sprout-015.name: Thornshell Crab
sprout-015.flavor: It loses the shell, never the will.

sprout-017.name: Regrowth
sprout-017.flavor: The wound closes before the blow.

sprout-021.name: Pollen Cloud
sprout-021.flavor: The enemy coughs. The enemy hesitates.

sprout-022.name: Coral Crown
sprout-022.flavor: It grows on the head of those who endure.

sprout-023.name: Root Lantern
sprout-023.flavor: A light that feeds on salt.

sprout-024.name: Kelp Forest
sprout-024.flavor: Here every blow gets lost in the green.

sprout-025.name: Spring Tide
sprout-025.flavor: When the moon is right, everything grows.

neutral-spark.name: Spark
neutral-spark.flavor: A small help for the one who starts second.
